facts.fact: The Inspector General of Police states that in 2024 the force plans to strengthen its business and case management systems under the ePIS project, which he calls an integrated digital platform for the management of policing services, and to embrace paperless transactions through ICT systems in all 29 regions.
The Inspector General of Police names no budget line or funder for the ePIS project in his message of 22 December 2023.
